nary_nodes.label: England vs Norway quarterfinal
evidence: We were treated to two brilliant quarterfinals yesterday, which saw both England and Argentina advance to the last four at the expense of Norway and Switzerland.

nary_nodes.label: Argentina vs Switzerland quarterfinal

evidence: Some very sad news broke yesterday when it was confirmed that South Africa’s Jayden Adams had died.
